reason: A named lab and a batch report that matches the number on the box is what I normally have to dig for, and bisglycinate with no oxide at a stated dose is the right form. At $24.99 for one box I'll try it, but I would not pay $29.99 on a first order.
objection: It is a brand I have never heard of, so I would open the lab report first and check that it is a real lab and that the report shows the magnesium amount and heavy metals. At $29.99 it is also pricier than the brands I already know.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open, did not name the lab, or showed a different batch number than the box, I would not buy. At the full $29.99 with no launch price I would probably wait for reviews.
